description: Reverses an auto_structure_groups run from the ledger: deletes the groups it created and puts every group it added members to back exactly as it was (from the snapshot taken just before the write). Refuses while a construction stage uses one of those groups, because deleting a group strips it from every stage. Default: the latest run not yet undone. Previews unless apply: true.

runId.description: Ledger run id; default = the latest auto_structure_groups run not yet undone.

name: auto_structure_groups_undo
title: Undo an Auto Structure Groups run
